reviewer_summary.question: Why must a chosen word be processed before choosing the following word, and what work do separate layer caches save?
reviewer_summary.takeaway: Choosing blue uses is’s finished result, while processing blue creates its own finished result using earlier keys and values that each layer can retain.

findings.problem: The reason for repeating The’s reading/update after its first-layer entry is rebuilt arrives only at the handoff.

resolution.note: Add the second-layer input-reconstruction goal before that work: first entry rebuilt; next entry requires the finished first-layer number.

findings.problem: Saying two equal numbers have different jobs leaves their jobs unspecified.

resolution.note: Explicitly distinguish the source preparation depending only on The from the match combining both pieces’ preparation.

findings.problem: Unexplained full-precision/simplified-sharing labels compete with the opening question.

resolution.note: Use plain opening notes and simple rounded-display language after the explicit rounding explanation. No early technical metadata label.
